title: California's 18th Congressional District General Election, 2026
description: The general election for California's 18th Congressional District will be held on November 3, 2026, following a top-two primary on June 2, 2026. The district includes parts of San Jose, Salinas, Watsonville, and surrounding communities in Monterey, San Benito, Santa Clara, and Santa Cruz counties. Incumbent Democrat Zoe Lofgren, who has held the seat since 1995 and serves as Ranking Member of the House Science, Space, and Technology Committee, faces Republican challenger Shane Lewis, a Marine Corps veteran and electrical test engineer. The district underwent redistricting under California Proposition 50, and Cook Political Report rates the race as Solid Democratic.
polling_note: No general election opinion polls were found for this race as of June 2026.

candidates.name: Zoe Lofgren
candidates.summary: Zoe Lofgren is the Democratic incumbent representing California's 18th Congressional District, first elected in 1994. She serves as Ranking Member of the House Science, Space, and Technology Committee and as a senior member of the House Judiciary Committee, and she chairs the California Democratic Congressional Delegation. Lofgren focuses on science and innovation policy, immigration reform, voting rights, and she served on the Select Committee to Investigate the January 6th Attack on the U.S. Capitol.

candidates.name: Shane Lewis
candidates.summary: Shane Lewis is the Republican candidate for California's 18th Congressional District. He is a Marine Corps veteran who joined the service shortly after high school, earning two meritorious promotions and qualifying as a paratrooper. He works as an R&D Electrical Test Engineer for a medical device company in San Jose and previously served as a Worship Leader and Elder at a local church while running a music business. Lewis emphasizes conservative positions on immigration reform, the Second Amendment, tax reform, reducing the national debt, and restoring what he views as consistency in federal governance.

forecast.rationale: No general-election polling exists for this race, reducing confidence. However, the available structural data strongly favors the Democratic incumbent. Zoe Lofgren has held this seat since 1995 and serves as Ranking Member of the House Science, Space, and Technology Committee. Cook Political Report rates CA-18 as Solid Democratic, reflecting the district's partisan lean encompassing parts of San Jose, Salinas, and surrounding Bay Area/Central Coast communities. The Republican challenger, Shane Lewis, is a first-time candidate without prior elected office. Absent any contrary polling evidence, the combination of incumbent seniority, favorable district fundamentals, and the Cook rating points to a very strong Democratic advantage consistent with a safe Democratic rating.
